energy_model.surfaces: field 0.06 (firm soil, ASAE D497 0.04–0.08); corridor/road 0.03 (hard surface, 0.02–0.04); tilled soil 0.10–0.16 not modelled

assumptions.ground: flat rigid plane; Coulomb friction; no deformable soil or terrain
assumptions.wheel_contact: rigid ring cylindrical tyres with finite contact width; no carcass flexibility, lugs or pressure effects; in-place rotation involves tyre scrub slip and is measured against a widened bound, not ideal rolling
assumptions.actuator: ideal wheel velocity servo with body speed/acceleration limits; no motor torque saturation in the loop; wheel torque demand is post-hoc accounting, not an enforced motor limit
assumptions.energy: post-hoc kinematic accounting from the truth trajectory: rolling resistance, longitudinal inertia and drive efficiency; no battery, motor current, thermal or terrain deformation model; braking recuperation not counted
assumptions.payload: constant mass uniformly distributed in the chassis box; task demand is abstract capacity, not kg
assumptions.localization: exact simulator world pose with source simulation timestamp; no sensor noise or estimator
assumptions.randomness: Fortress 6.18 CLI/control has no supported seed setter; no stochastic sensors configured; bitwise determinism is not claimed
assumptions.calibration: synthetic parameters; no real-machine calibration; simulation verification only

physics_audit.scope: rigid body geometry/inertia and explicit engine configuration; not empirical physical calibration

physics_runtime.scope: owned process mappings plus Gazebo selection logs; loaded alternatives do not imply they were selected

truth_timing.scope: Gazebo PosePublisher 每车模型姿态；源仿真时间；新会话拒绝零时间戳，不再使用接收时钟近似
